title: 第14章 斗拳场的老板第4章 生活的参差
content_zh:
源器。
是能与武者体内源质产生共鸣，发挥出奇异力量的装备。
王生在学校也只是听说过，却还从未见过这种东西，如今第一次接触，只觉神奇万分。
他的惊讶被刘坤看在眼里：
‘果然，这少年的确家境贫寒，不然也不应该连源器都没碰过，看来是捡到宝了。’
刘坤情绪掩饰得极好，不动声色道：
“一点小小的见面礼而已，既然你不想泄露身份，那还用这种劣质的皮制面具可不行，怕是打不了多少场就坏了。”
劣质么？
王生心里暗自嘀咕，他可是花很多钱，挑了质量最好的一款。
想着，王生摸了摸脸，却发现面具表面果然已经被磨得粗糙不堪，内里似乎也被自己死亡时碎裂的骨头给磨破了不少地方。
这个时候被送了一件面具源器，还挺贴心。
王生不由点头道：
“谢谢。”
他接过面具和衣服，前往了房间内的浴室。
浴室内很香，似乎是点了花香气息的香氛蜡烛，还非常干净整洁，应该是每天都有人打扫。
“貌似这里都是女人用的东西，拳场老板是个女的吗？”
还是说这老板包养的女秘书用的房间？
脑子里想着有的没的，王生手上动作也没停，将脸上、身上的血迹仔仔细细洗干净，又用了很香很香的沐浴露和洗发水。
顿时，人感觉清爽了不少。
“舒服啊。”

王生快速换上衣服，把头发吹干，最后再将面具戴上。
那面具摸起来感觉很怪，又硬又软的，戴在脸上尺寸还不合适。
可没一会儿，面具就自行调整大小，顺着王生面部起伏完成了贴合，触肤的感觉很舒适，不闷。
“好神奇，这种源器最便宜也得卖六位数吧？”
要知道自己打赢这场比赛，也就只能拿两万块钱，面具的价值都比酬劳高了。
可见王生有多受重视。
“很好，以后提升实力和来钱的门路就都有了。”
待会儿见了老板可得态度好点，有这么一个舍得砸钱，赏识他的金主，怎能错过大腿？
想着，王生很快离开浴室，来到办公客厅，坐在了一旁沙发上等候。
不多时。
房门外传来了款款的高跟鞋声音。
“哒、哒、哒......”
content_en:
source.
It is a piece of equipment that can resonate with the essence of the warrior's body and exert strange power.
Wang Sheng had only heard of it in school, but had never seen such a thing. Now that he had encountered it for the first time, he felt it was extremely magical.
His surprise was seen by Liu Kun:
‘Sure enough, this young man does come from a poor family, otherwise he shouldn’t have even touched the Origin Artifact. It seems he has found a treasure. ’
Liu Kun concealed his emotions very well and said calmly:
"It's just a small greeting gift. Since you don't want to reveal your identity, you can't use such a low-quality leather mask. I'm afraid it will break after just a few fights."
Is it inferior?
Wang Sheng muttered to himself that he had spent a lot of money to choose the one with the best quality.
Thinking about it, Wang Sheng touched his face, only to find that the surface of the mask had indeed been worn rough, and the inside seemed to have been worn out in many places by the broken bones when he died.
At this time, I was given a mask generator, which was quite considerate.
Wang Sheng couldn't help but nodded and said:
"Thank you."
He took the mask and clothes and went to the bathroom in the room.
The bathroom smells very good, it seems to have been lit with scented candles that smell of flowers. It is also very clean and tidy. It should be cleaned every day.
"It seems like everything here is for women. Is the owner of the boxing ring a woman?"
Or is it the room used by the female secretary kept by the boss?
With all these thoughts in his mind, Wang Sheng didn't stop moving his hands. He carefully washed away the blood on his face and body, and used a very fragrant shower gel and shampoo.
Suddenly, people felt a lot more refreshed.
"It's comfortable."
Wang Sheng quickly changed his clothes, dried his hair, and finally put on the mask.
The mask felt weird to the touch, hard and soft at the same time, and the size didn't fit right on my face.
But after a while, the mask adjusted its size by itself and followed the ups and downs of Wang Sheng's face to fit it. It felt very comfortable against the skin and not stuffy.
"It's amazing. The cheapest source device like this costs six figures, right?"
You must know that if you win this game, you can only get 20,000 yuan, and the value of the mask is higher than the reward.
This shows how much Wang Sheng is taken seriously.
"Very good. There will be ways to improve your strength and make money in the future."
You need to have a better attitude when you meet your boss later. With such a sponsor who is willing to spend money and appreciates him, how can you miss his big deal?
Thinking about it, Wang Sheng quickly left the bathroom, came to the office living room, and sat on the sofa to wait.
Not long after.
The sound of high heels could be heard outside the door.
"Da, da, da..."
